workarounds.symptom: Mode A で openai/gpt-* を使うと enable_thinking / chat_template_kwargs が OpenAI API に送られ 400 になる
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(litellm): stop sending vLLM thinking fields to OpenAI-hosted models. Target files: core/execution/base.py, core/execution/engines/litellm/_litellm_context.py, scripts/i18n/manifest.json. In Mode A, every `openai/` model got `enable_thinking` and `chat_template_kwargs` in `extra_body`. Those fields switch thinking in the chat template of self-hosted servers (vLLM, llama.cpp). The OpenAI API rejects them with `400 Unrecognized request argument supplied: enable_thinking`. (Ref: https://github.com/xuiltul/animaworks/pull/430)

workarounds.symptom: fix: _check_process_health STOPPING-stuck path writes failure state without a shutdown guard
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: guard remaining failure-tracking writers against mid-shutdown races. Target files: core/supervisor/_mgr_health.py, core/supervisor/_mgr_reconcile.py, core/supervisor/manager.py. `shutdown_all()` sets `self._shutdown = True` so the failure-tracking machinery (`_failure_reasons`, `_permanently_failed`, `_start_fail_counts`/`_start_failed_times`, `handle.state = FAILED`) becomes a no-op during teardown: state written after shutdown begins is never read again and only pollutes the next server start. Follow-up to #241/#242... (Ref: https://github.com/xuiltul/animaworks/pull/244)
